summary: The FDA recall of TRP The Relief Products Gentle Eyes Lubricant Eye Drops (lots 3279 and 3292) due to lack of assurance of sterility has not been mirrored by any other national regulator, WHO, or regional agency in the sources examined. No additional reports of the same product or batch numbers appear in international databases or credible news outlets beyond the original U.S. alert.
